name: cpig-69-self-supporting
description: 69 Self-Supporting Modifier (R6.5 Phase E Batch 1 — Conformality)

setup.vlmDescription: A light-blue dome or hemisphere shape with a visible stepped or layered surface texture, centered in the viewport.
setup.whatItDoes: Forces the source field surface to remain self-supporting for additive manufacturing. Mode 0 (Mask) clips where overhang exceeds; Mode 1 (Blend) smoothly mixes with a safe field.
setup.whatYouShouldSee: A light-blue dome/hemisphere with a stepped or layered surface texture. Distinguish from an unmodified sphere by the stepped/angled surface.

requires.fix: install the Slop yak package; on a dev machine a Release net48 build ships it to the Drive folder GH loads from - check `canary doctor` output for the location actually in use
install the CPig yak package, or on a dev machine build %CANARY_REPO_CPIG% CPig.Grasshopper (net48) and register its output folder in Grasshopper Developer Settings
this test loads a Slop definition from the CANARY_REPO_CPIG repo; check that repo out and point %CANARY_REPO_CPIG% at it (see workloads/tokens.json)
